title: Zebra in a little scarf
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='24' ry='16' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Stripes on body -->
  <path d='M38 50 Q40 62 38 74' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M46 48 Q48 62 46 76' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 48 Q56 62 54 76' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M62 50 Q64 62 62 74' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='34' y='74' width='6' height='16' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='46' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='58' y='76' width='6' height='14' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <rect x='62' y='74' width='6' height='16' rx='2' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Hooves -->
  <rect x='34' y='88' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <rect x='46' y='88' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <rect x='58' y='88' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <rect x='62' y='88' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <!-- Neck -->
  <path d='M48 50 Q46 38 44 30' stroke='#e8e8f0' stroke-width='10' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Neck stripes -->
  <path d='M44 34 L52 32' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M43 40 L51 38' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M43 46 L51 44' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='44' cy='24' rx='12' ry='10' fill='#e8e8f0'/>
  <!-- Muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='28' rx='7' ry='6' fill='#f0e0d0'/>
  <!-- Nostril -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='28' r='1.2' fill='#6a4a3a'/>
  <!-- Head stripes -->
  <path d='M48 16 Q46 24 48 30' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M54 18 Q52 24 54 28' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Ear left -->
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='12' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(-20 38 12)'/>
  <ellipse cx='38' cy='12' rx='2' ry='4.5' fill='#d8a8b8' transform='rotate(-20 38 12)'/>
  <!-- Ear right -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='12' rx='4' ry='7' fill='#e8e8f0' transform='rotate(15 50 12)'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='12' rx='2' ry='4.5' fill='#d8a8b8' transform='rotate(15 50 12)'/>
  <!-- Eye -->
  <circle cx='44' cy='22' r='2.5' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <circle cx='44.8' cy='21.2' r='0.8' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Mane -->
  <path d='M52 16 Q58 18 56 24 Q60 26 56 32' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Scarf -->
  <path d='M42 36 Q50 32 58 36 Q60 40 58 42 Q50 38 42 42 Q40 40 42 36Z' fill='#e04050'/>
  <!-- Scarf knot -->
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='40' rx='4' ry='3.5' fill='#d03040'/>
  <!-- Scarf tail -->
  <path d='M58 42 Q64 46 62 54 Q60 50 56 46Z' fill='#e04050'/>
  <path d='M58 44 L60 52' stroke='#d03040' stroke-width='1.5' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Tail -->
  <path d='M72 58 Q80 54 82 60' stroke='#3a3a6a' stroke-width='2.5' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='61' r='3' fill='#3a3a6a'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M30 30 Q32 33 35 31' stroke='#6a4a3a' stroke-width='1' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
